summary: Iteration 16 tested (a) UI redesign for Deposit, Referrals, Marketplace confirm-invest drawer, Investments list, and UserLayout header/bottom-nav (b) polished Light Mode toggle from both the user-side header AND the admin header, and (c) the /api/investments backend enrichment (product_image_url + product_tier). All redesign items landed correctly. Light mode toggle works from both surfaces — html.theme-light class, parchment body bg (rgb(251,247,238)), and localStorage nb-theme='light' persist across reloads. Text inside dark-gold ambient cards correctly stays white while page-level text-white flips to dark parchment. One design issue found in ADMIN panel light mode: stat-card values and payment-gateway list content are nearly invisible (very low contrast) — the user-side dashboard light mode is fine because it uses AmbientCards that remain dark, but the admin panel uses plain nb-card surfaces whose inline/child text colors are not fully covered by the current light-mode overrides in index.css.

issues: Stat card values (Total Users: 14, Invested Users: 2, Pending Deposits: 13, Total Deposited ₦3,000, etc.) render in a near-white color on the parchment background — practically invisible / fails AA contrast. Root cause: KPI numbers are wrapped in elements that use color tokens other than plain `text-white` (likely `text-[var(--nb-text)]` with a color still tuned for dark bg, or hardcoded hex). The existing `html.theme-light .text-white` rule does not catch them.
'Payment gateway' row (PayNow · Merchant 10205), gateway balance, and Quick-action tile labels are also washed out in light mode for the same reason.
The gateway icon glyph (bolt) becomes invisible white-on-white.

action_items: Fix admin panel light-mode contrast: add explicit light-mode overrides in index.css for the admin stat cards / gateway rows / quick-action tiles. Suggested approach: broaden the light-mode text override beyond `.text-white` (e.g. also flip elements colored with `text-[#F8FAFC]` and any inline `color: rgb(248,250,252)`), OR restyle Admin KPI/list surfaces to use `text-[var(--nb-text)]` so they follow the variable flip automatically. Optionally give the admin content surface (`AdminLayout` main area) a `data-nb-admin-surface` marker and add a scoped rule.

(Optional low-priority) The Deposit page's MethodBlock + amount card visually match the dark-gold ambient treatment (verified via screenshot — dashed gold accents, dark gradient bg, gold submit pill), but they do NOT carry the `data-nb-ambient='gold'` attribute. If those two blocks ever need to preserve white text in light mode they should either be switched to <AmbientCard> or receive the attribute so the light-mode CSS rule applies. Not urgent — Deposit is not currently affected because inputs there are visible in both themes.
critical_code_review_comments: Light-mode strategy relies on matching the React-rendered inline string `rgb(30, 27, 10)` for #1E1B0A. That is fragile — a future refactor that changes the gradient by 1 pixel-hex or switches to a class-based bg would silently break the white-text preservation. The `data-nb-ambient='gold'` attribute on AmbientCard is the robust selector; the CSS should preferentially use that and only keep the rgb() selector as a legacy fallback.

rca of the issue: Admin light-mode contrast bug: the light-mode override in index.css only catches `.text-white` and elements inside `[style*='rgb(30, 27, 10)']` / `[data-nb-ambient='gold']`. Admin panel KPI values and gateway rows use non-`.text-white` classes (likely `text-[var(--nb-text)]` or hardcoded near-white hex) that don't flip. Mitigation options: (1) refactor admin cards to consistently use `text-[var(--nb-text)]`; (2) add explicit selectors in index.css for the admin panel container; (3) wrap AdminLayout content in a `data-nb-admin-surface` div and scope color overrides to it.
